# descope_oidc_app (Resource)

Manages a single OIDC federated application where Descope acts as the identity provider.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A name for the OIDC application.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project that this application belongs to. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.

### Optional

- `approved_redirect_urls` (Set of String) A list of approved redirect URLs for this application (supports `*` wildcards). When set, redirect URIs are validated against this per-app list; when empty, validation falls back to the project's approved/trusted domains.
- `authorization_code_disabled` (Boolean) Disables the `authorization_code` grant type for this application.
- `backchannel_logout_url` (String) The URL that Descope notifies with a logout token when the user's session ends, as per the [OIDC Back-Channel Logout](https://openid.net/specs/openid-connect-backchannel-1_0.html) specification. Leave empty to disable back-channel logout notifications for this application.
- `claims` (List of String) A list of supported claims. e.g. `sub`, `email`, `exp`.
- `client_credentials_disabled` (Boolean) Disables the `client_credentials` grant type for this application.
- `client_id` (String) A dedicated OIDC `client_id` to import for this application. When omitted, the `client_id` is generated by the server and is not returned on reads. Can only be set when the application is created, and changing it will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) A dedicated OIDC `client_secret` to import for this application. When omitted, a secret is generated server-side only for applications with a `confidential` client type, either on creation or when the application is later switched to `confidential`, and fetched into the Terraform state. Applications with other client types don't use a client secret and the value stays empty. The value in the state is never overwritten afterwards, so a secret rotated via the API or the Descope console is not reflected until the resource is replaced. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.
- `client_type` (String) OAuth client confidentiality. One of `""` (default — legacy access-key authentication), `"confidential"` (a dedicated client secret is generated for the app), or `"public"` (PKCE only, no client secret). Changing this value on an existing application changes how its clients must authenticate, so coordinate the change with the application's developers.
- `custom_idp_initiated_login_page_url` (String) A custom login page URL to redirect users to on IdP-initiated login flows, instead of the default login page.
- `default_audience` (String) Controls the default `aud` claim of tokens issued for this application. One of `"projectId"` (the project ID only), `"clientId"` (the dedicated client ID only), `"appId"` (the application ID only), `"empty"` (no `aud` claim at all), or `""` (default — both the project ID and the client ID). Only applies to modern apps that set a `client_type`; legacy apps always use the project ID, so the empty default leaves their behavior unchanged.
- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Protects the application from being accidentally destroyed or replaced. Destroying or replacing a federated application breaks the service provider's configured integration and invalidates its client credentials, so these applications are protected by default. To allow the resource to be destroyed or replaced, for example in ephemeral test environments, set this attribute to `false` and apply the change first.
- `description` (String) A description for the OIDC application.
- `device_code_disabled` (Boolean) Disables the `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code` grant type for this application.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the application should be enabled or disabled.
- `force_authentication` (Boolean) This configuration overrides the default behavior of the SSO application and forces the user to authenticate via the Descope flow, regardless of the SP's request.
- `force_pkce` (Boolean) When enabled, the authorization code flow requires PKCE in addition to the normal client authentication. A confidential client must then present both its client secret and a valid PKCE `code_verifier`. Public clients always use PKCE regardless of this setting.
- `id` (String) An optional identifier for the application. When omitted, an identifier is generated by the server. Can only be set when the application is created, and changing it will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.
- `jwt_bearer_disabled` (Boolean) Disables the `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer` grant type for this application.
- `login_page_url` (String) The Flow Hosting URL. When left empty the project's default login page URL is used, and the computed value is reflected in this attribute. Read more about using this parameter with custom domain [here](https://docs.descope.com/sso-integrations/applications/saml-apps).
- `logo` (String) A logo for the OIDC application. Should be a hosted image URL.
- `refresh_token_disabled` (Boolean) Disables the `refresh_token` grant type for this application.
- `trusted_apps_audience` (String) Controls the audience values appended to the issued token's `aud` claim for trusted sibling applications. One of `"projectId"`, `"clientId"`, `"appId"`, `"empty"` (add none), or `""` (default — both the project ID and the client ID). Independent of `default_audience`.
